_comments.source: Hand-curated 2026-04-05. Tear of one or more of the four rotator cuff tendons (supraspinatus most common). Diagnosis via MRI/ultrasound, treatment ranges from PT/injection to arthroscopic or open repair.
_comments.hcpcs_rationale: 29827 arthroscopic rotator cuff repair is the dominant modern surgical code. 23410/23412 are open acute/chronic repair. 23420 is repair with acromioclavicular release. 29826 is subacromial decompression (often bundled). 29822/29823 are debridement codes. 20610/20611 are arthrocentesis / US-guided shoulder injection — the common non-op intervention.
_comments.taxonomy_rationale: Orthopedic Surgery is the dominant specialty, especially Sports Medicine and Hand Surgery sub-certs. PM&R Sports and Family/IM Sports Medicine also see these patients for non-op management.
_comments.pubmed_rationale: Procedural and diagnostic names, dominant anatomical variants (supraspinatus), common operative approaches.
